description: Krea 2's own learned per-tap weighting over the 12 text-layer taps, extracted from the diffusion model. A model-intrinsic prior for the layers gain tables (Stage 0 of the derivation methodology in README section 4).
caveat: The projector combines taps AFTER per-tap layerwise/refiner blocks; the node's gains act on the raw tap delta BEFORE that processing. So this is a prior and sanity check on relative tap importance, not a literal gain table. The node->pixel path is nonlinear.
